title.narrative: Conservation of Heritage under Threat due to Conflict in Sudan

description.narrative: The work plan includes an integrated concept about the antiquities, monuments and world heritage sites under danger in Sudan, and the accompanying comprehensive and partial destruction, and other sites that have been subjected to looting and bombing, in addition to agricultural expansions in world heritage sites, and the boom in gold mining and many other relevant impacts that might occur as a result of conflict. The proposal included several activities to address war impact on sites that have already been affected and to establish preventive measures for those that not yet been affected but are under threat, including Capacity building for strengthening the capacities of the NCAM staff and train them in damage assessment, security measures, risk mitigations, restoration, reconstruction and rehabilitation for the movable and immovable cultural heritage. This should include the damaged antiquities, museums and historical buildings that are affected by the war all over the Sudan.
